blocks.html:
Custom Screen Printing for Victor's Historic Gold Camp Community

Victor is one of Colorado's most authentic historic towns — a former gold rush boomtown that once housed 18,000 people at its peak, now home to about 400 full-time residents who have chosen to preserve and live in the City of Mines. Unlike neighboring Cripple Creek, Victor opted out of casino gambling, keeping its authentic character intact. The community attracts history enthusiasts, artists, and outdoor recreationists exploring the Cripple Creek and Victor area, generating demand for small-run custom apparel for events, local businesses, and community organizations.

Victor shares the Cripple Creek-Victor School District with Cripple Creek. The town's strong historic identity means community events, anniversaries, and tourism occasions regularly call for custom merchandise. For a community this size, DTF printing with no minimum order is the right fit — allowing a single shirt, a small run of event tees, or custom pieces for local businesses without requiring a large screen printing commitment.
